result.summary: Identified 2 minor layout and styling issues involving text clipping and edge cutoffs in horizontal carousels.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the horizontal list is abruptly truncated at the screen edge without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with ellipsis or adjust container padding to prevent clipped text.

issues.description: The category filter pill on the far right is cut off abruptly without a subtle fade or scroll cue.
issues.suggestion: Add edge padding or a subtle gradient fade to signal horizontal scrollability.
